color_truth: Pinned original PSD RGBA; unchanged CORE025 default CPU/browser references
domain: Per-source-coordinate max alpha of the unshifted white, pupil and highlight; moved source alpha capped by this fixed domain
coupled_gaze_domain: Horizontal max-alpha dilation of the original paint domain by 8 source pixels; a fixed alpha-derived envelope for the validated command range, preserving the moved iris lower contour
manual_layer_domain: Legacy unshifted source-paint cap unless the eye's coupled gaze envelope was explicitly activated; pose reports active envelopes separately from manual/coupled control state
native_equation: premultiplied RGBout=Cs*Ad+Cd*(1-As); Aout=Ad; not source-alpha multiplication plus Normal
artist_override_reason: PSD iris extends below raw white alpha; white-only multiplication removes source artwork
